definitions: A type of rock formation that rises from the floor of a cave due to the accumulation of material deposited on the floor from ceiling drippings.
A cone-shaped deposit of calcium carbonate that builds up on the floor of a cave.
examples: The cave tour highlighted impressive stalagmites.
Water dripping from the ceiling formed a stalagmite over centuries.
Visitors were warned not to touch the delicate stalagmite formations.
